notes.title: About TMNT Portal Power
notes.content:
Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles travel through portals and fight evil in this action-packed street fighting game. You'll punch, kick, power-up and portal your way through outrageous dimensions to stop Shredder and the Kraang from unleashing another diabolical plot. Worlds collide with Classic Krang battles on the rooftops of New York and an ultimate Kraang Subprime showdown in the Technodrome.
[*] Controls: compatible with both keyboard/mouse and controllers, now with the ability to switch between turtles on the fly, or move and attack with all four at once
[*] Combat: enemy encounters and boss battles have been rebalanced for more challenging gameplay.
[*] Costumes: ALL costumes – even the ones behind in-app purchases on mobile – are now acquirable in-game, including the '80s and comic-styled looks
[*] Smarter Turtles: characters you don’t control will now fight and dodge on their own. Don’t get complacent – you’ll still need to lead the battle to activate their special moves!


GAME FEATURES: 
 [*] Playable characters Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey
 [*] A variety of astonishing TMNT dimensions through which you can punch, kick, attack, and portal
 [*] Enemies like the Foot Clan, Shredder, Bebop, Rocksteady, and many others
 [*] Costumes to suit up and unlock even more ninja moves and levels
 [*] Official voices and animation from the same people who bring you TMNT on Nick
 [*] Ability to battle across new 5 worlds and dimensions in the all-new TMNT Portal Power game
 [*] Includes the Kraang Invasion content, featuring '80s Krang and the Technodrome!
